name: 役職手当・固定手当 (fixed allowance)
authority: 健康保険法 art.3(5) and 厚生年金保険法 art.3(1)(iii) (報酬), 雇用保険法 art.4(4) (賃金) and 所得税法 art.28 (給与所得): a fixed allowance is remuneration, salary income and in the overtime base.

name: 家族手当 (family allowance)
authority: Remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)), wages for employment insurance and salary income; excluded from the overtime base (労働基準法 art.37(5)) — the lineage's overtime base includes it, over-paying rather than under-paying.

name: 住宅手当 (housing allowance)
authority: Remuneration, wages and salary income; excluded from the overtime base only where it varies with the housing cost (労働基準法施行規則 art.21(iii), 平成11年3月31日 基発170号).

name: 通勤手当 (commuting allowance)
authority: 所得税法 art.9(1)(v) with 施行令 art.20の2: up to 150,000 yen a month is not taxable for public transport (INCOME_TAX.COMMUTING: only the excess is taxed); it is remuneration for social insurance (健保法 art.3(5)) and wages for labour insurance. The distance-based limits for car commuters (施行令 art.20の2(ii), revised from 20 November 2025) are not modelled.
